title: Define deterministic fast-path event envelope
objective: Define the repository-local event contract that an external immediate relay will later use to wake the orchestration brain without relying on ChatGPT Work polling or native Work webhooks.
acceptance_criteria: Define an immutable OrchestrationEvent representation for repository, pull-request number, event type, event id, commit sha, and task id.
Support at least cursor_result, ci_completed, and human_decision event types.
Provide deterministic serialization suitable for durable comparison and idempotency checks.
Provide an idempotency_key derived only from stable event identity fields.
Reject missing or empty required identifiers.
No networking, credentials, API calls, GitHub writes, Cursor calls, OpenAI calls, merges, or deployments are introduced.
